verdict.rationale: EFTPS documents self-service status visibility for payments only: immediate payment acknowledgement, email notifications to track a payment, and 15 months of payment history. These sit inside the MFA-gated account rather than on public pages, and nothing lets a founder check the status of an enrollment application or a case online; enrollment instead concludes with a PIN arriving by mail. missing for 10: public (unauthenticated) status lookup pages, enrollment/application status tracking, case status lookup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
